# List Recent Tickets

## Prerequisites

- The authenticated user must be an **Agent** (endpoint is “Allowed For: Agents”).

## Method

`GET`

## URL

`https://{{OAUTH_REQUEST_PAYLOAD.formData.ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN}}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets/recent`

## Headers

```json
{
  "Accept": "application/json"
}
```

## Description

Lists tickets that the requesting agent **recently viewed in the agent interface** (this is **not** a list of recently created or recently updated tickets).

## Enforcement Rules

- There are **no path parameters** for this endpoint.
- When executing the action, send **Query Parameters in the URL** (if any are supported). Do **not** send query parameters in the body.
- This endpoint uses `GET` and therefore should **not** include a request body.

## Response

### Success Response (200 OK)

Returns JSON containing a `tickets` array of ticket objects.

```json
{
  "tickets": [
    {
      "id": 123456789,
      "url": "https://example.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets/123456789.json",
      "subject": "Printer not working",
      "raw_subject": "Printer not working",
      "description": "The printer on floor 2 is jammed again.",
      "status": "open",
      "priority": "normal",
      "type": "incident",
      "requester_id": 987654321,
      "submitter_id": 987654321,
      "assignee_id": 111222333,
      "group_id": 444555666,
      "organization_id": 777888999,
      "tags": [
        "hardware",
        "printer"
      ],
      "created_at": "2026-03-01T12:34:56Z",
      "updated_at": "2026-03-02T09:10:11Z",
      "allow_attachments": true,
      "allow_channelback": false,
      "collaborator_ids": [
        222333444
      ],
      "custom_fields": [
        {
          "id": 360000000001,
          "value": "floor_2"
        }
      ],
      "via": {
        "channel": "web",
        "source": {}
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

> Note: The scraped documentation did not include a complete example payload; the structure above reflects the documented fields and typical Zendesk ticket shape.

### Error Responses

Error responses were not provided in the scraped content.

## Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tickets` | array | List of tickets recently viewed by the requesting agent |
| `tickets[].allow_attachments` | boolean | Permission for agents to add attachments to a comment. Defaults to `true` |
| `tickets[].allow_channelback` | boolean | `false` if channelback is disabled, `true` otherwise. Only applicable for channels framework ticket |
| `tickets[].assignee_email` | string | Write only. Email address of the agent to assign the ticket to |
| `tickets[].assignee_id` | integer | The agent currently assigned to the ticket |
| `tickets[].attribute_value_ids` | array of integer | Write only. IDs of attribute values to associate with the ticket |
| `tickets[].brand_id` | integer | Brand ID the ticket is associated with |
| `tickets[].collaborator_ids` | array of integer | IDs of users currently CC’ed on the ticket |
| `tickets[].collaborators` | array of object | POST requests only. Users to add as CCs when creating a ticket |
| `tickets[].collaborators[].email` | string | Collaborator email |
| `tickets[].collaborators[].name` | string | Collaborator name |
| `tickets[].comment` | object | Write only. Object that adds a comment to the ticket |
| `tickets[].created_at` | string | When the record was created |
| `tickets[].custom_fields` | array of object | Custom fields for the ticket |
| `tickets[].custom_fields[].id` | integer | Custom field ID |
| `tickets[].custom_fields[].value` | string | Custom field value |
| `tickets[].custom_status_id` | integer | Custom ticket status ID |
| `tickets[].description` | string | Read-only first comment on the ticket. When creating a ticket, use `comment` to set the description |
| `tickets[].due_at` | string | Due date for tickets of type `"task"` (ISO 8601) |
| `tickets[].email_cc_ids` | array of integer | IDs of agents or end users currently CC’ed (ignored if CCs and followers not enabled) |
| `tickets[].email_ccs` | object | Write only. Represents email CCs to add or delete (ignored if CCs and followers not enabled) |
| `tickets[].encoded_id` | string | Encoded string representing the ticket’s unique identifier |
| `tickets[].external_id` | string | External ID to link Zendesk tickets to local records |
| `tickets[].follower_ids` | array of integer | IDs of agents following the ticket (ignored if CCs and followers not enabled) |
| `tickets[].followers` | object | Write only. Represents followers to add or delete (ignored if CCs and followers not enabled) |
| `tickets[].followup_ids` | array of integer | IDs of followups created from this ticket (visible once ticket is closed) |
| `tickets[].forum_topic_id` | integer | Topic in the deprecated Zendesk Web portal (if any) |
| `tickets[].from_messaging_channel` | boolean | If `true`, the ticket’s via type is a messaging channel |
| `tickets[].generated_timestamp` | integer | Unix timestamp representing the most accurate last-updated reading |
| `tickets[].group_id` | integer | Group the ticket is assigned to |
| `tickets[].has_incidents` | boolean | `true` if ticket is a problem type with linked incidents; otherwise `false` |
| `tickets[].id` | integer | Ticket ID |
| `tickets[].is_public` | boolean | `true` if any comments are public; otherwise `false` |
| `tickets[].macro_id` | integer | Write only. Macro ID to record in the ticket audit |
| `tickets[].macro_ids` | array of integer | POST requests only. Macro IDs to record in the ticket audit |
| `tickets[].metadata` | object | Write only. Metadata for the audit |
| `tickets[].organization_id` | integer | Requester’s organization ID (must be associated with requester) |
| `tickets[].priority` | string | Urgency: `urgent`, `high`, `normal`, `low` |
| `tickets[].problem_id` | integer | For `"incident"` tickets, ID of the linked problem ticket |
| `tickets[].raw_subject` | string | Dynamic content placeholder if present, otherwise the subject value |
| `tickets[].recipient` | string | Original recipient email address; notifications are sent from this address |
| `tickets[].requester` | object | Write only. Requester object (used when creating with a new requester) |
| `tickets[].requester_id` | integer | The user who requested the ticket |
| `tickets[].safe_update` | boolean | Write only. Protects against update collisions when used with `update_stamp` |
| `tickets[].satisfaction_rating` | object | Satisfaction rating object |
| `tickets[].sharing_agreement_ids` | array of integer | IDs of sharing agreements used for this ticket |
| `tickets[].status` | string | State: `new`, `open`, `pending`, `hold`, `solved`, `closed` |
| `tickets[].subject` | string | Ticket subject |
| `tickets[].submitter_id` | integer | User who submitted the ticket |
| `tickets[].tags` | array of string | Tags applied to the ticket (set behavior overwrites/replaces unless specified otherwise) |
| `tickets[].ticket_form_id` | integer | Enterprise only. Ticket form ID |
| `tickets[].type` | string | Type: `problem`, `incident`, `question`, `task` |
| `tickets[].updated_at` | string | When the record was last updated (updated only if update generates a ticket event) |
| `tickets[].updated_stamp` | string | Write only. Datetime of last update received from API (used with `safe_update`) |
| `tickets[].url` | string | API URL of the ticket |
| `tickets[].via` | object | Via object describing how the ticket/event was created |
| `tickets[].via.channel` | string | Channel (examples include `web`, `mobile`, `rule`, `system`) |
| `tickets[].via.source` | object | Source payload (free-form) |
| `tickets[].via_followup_source_id` | integer | POST requests only. ID of a closed ticket when creating a follow-up |
| `tickets[].via_id` | integer | Write only. Via ID (see Via object reference) |
| `tickets[].voice_comment` | object | Write only. Voice comment object |

## Sample Request

```bash
curl -i --request GET \
  --url 'https://{{OAUTH_REQUEST_PAYLOAD.formData.ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN}}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets/recent' \
  --header 'Accept: application/json'
```

## Notes

- The scraped content did not list any query parameters for this endpoint.
- Many fields in the ticket object are marked **write-only** in the scraped content; they may not appear in responses even though they are part of the ticket schema.
